steps.text: THE CABINET MARQUEE READS: 999 GAMES IN 1. ALL OF THEM COUNTERFEIT.
steps.speaker: ANNOUNCER

steps.text: LICKSPITTLE DIVES INTO THE COIN SLOT WITH THE BABY. SHE ATE THE MASTER CARTRIDGE'S CHIP.
steps.speaker: ANNOUNCER

steps.text: THE FAMILY FOLLOWS. NOBODY READS THE WARNING STICKER.
NOW ENTERING: THE CABINET. PLEASE KEEP HANDS INSIDE THE GAME AT ALL TIMES.
steps.speaker: ANNOUNCER
